test: Check core and add-on subscriptions
expected: SKU status and assignment reviewed with renewal/expiration distinction
observed: Business Premium and E5 IPG active with both expiration dates confirmed. Recurring billing is Off for both products. PILOT add-on assignment verified under LIC-03.
notes: Operator-reported billing readback.

test: Verify pilot and control entitlements
expected: Required base products and enabled SharePoint service plans verified on both internal test users
observed: PILOT has Business Premium with Copilot. CONTROL has Business Premium. Both have SharePoint Online Plan 1 enabled.
notes: Operator-reported per-user license and service plan readback.

test: Verify IPG benefit prerequisites and service-side auto-labeling
expected: Applicable prerequisite and pilot assignment confirmed together with feature accessibility
observed: Business Premium is a qualifying prerequisite under MCA Product Terms. PILOT has Business Premium with Copilot and E5 IPG assigned. Pilot SharePoint site selected in the auto-labeling wizard.
notes: Operator confirmed both assigned products. File-level test planned for Stage 3.

test: Open Data Loss Prevention Policies
expected: Policies page and Create policy command visible
observed: Policies page and Create policy visible in operator capture.

test: Check custom DLP policy Locations
expected: SharePoint sites selectable in the custom-policy wizard
observed: Lab operator confirmed SharePoint sites is selectable.
notes: Site scope and enforcement have separate tests.

test: GUEST opens BFL-021.docx
expected: Named guest opens neutral file under baseline SharePoint permissions
observed: Controlled guest opened the neutral document in Word for the web through named-file access.
notes: Retain the working neutral access link privately for the DLP acceptance test.

test: Run v1 on 20 tuning fixtures
expected: Result for every file and confusion matrix computed
observed: 20 of 20 fixtures evaluated with 8 TP and 3 FP and 0 FN and 9 TN.
notes: PASS records completed evaluation. False positives were BFL-013 and BFL-014 and BFL-017.

test: Run v2 on 20 tuning fixtures
expected: Result for every file. Compare with v1 and explain remaining misclassifications.
observed: 20 of 20 fixtures evaluated with 8 TP and 0 FP and 0 FN and 12 TN.
notes: False positives fell from 3 to 0. Saved v2 selected for the separate holdout run.

test: Run frozen v2 on ten holdout fixtures
expected: One observed evaluation and confusion matrix for reserved corpus
observed: 10 of 10 fixtures evaluated with 4 TP and 0 FP and 0 FN and 6 TN.
notes: Operator-reported results on the reserved corpus.

test: Apply BFL Finance Confidential to BFL-022.xlsx
expected: Manual label persists in SharePoint or reopened Office file
observed: SharePoint showed BFL Finance Confidential in the Sensitivity column for BFL-022.xlsx after manual labeling.
notes: Verified in the Finance-Test library.

test: Apply BFL Internal to BFL-024.xlsx
expected: Manual label persists in SharePoint or reopened Office file
observed: SharePoint showed BFL Internal in the Sensitivity column for BFL-024.xlsx after manual labeling.
notes: Verified in the Finance-Test library.

test: Evaluate BFL-005.docx and BFL-021.docx with named access for the same guest
expected: Positive SIT match with the external-sharing condition met on both files and no neutral match after evaluation
observed: Completed SharePoint scan of 13 files on 1 site. BFL-005.docx was the sole match.
notes: Neutral no-match inferred from the completed site scan and sole reported match. Both files had named guest access.

test: Evaluate label-only BFL-022.xlsx and unlabeled BFL-021.docx
expected: Only the manually labeled neutral fixture matches the isolated label policy
observed: Completed simulation showed three SharePoint entries for BFL-022.xlsx under BFL Confidential Label Match.
notes: Review was filtered to 20 November 2026. BFL-021.docx was absent from the displayed results.

test: GUEST opens BFL-005.docx and BFL-021.docx before enforcement
expected: Both original named-file links open in the controlled guest session
observed: The same controlled guest opened both files in view-only mode.
notes: Operator confirmed the neutral fixture readback. Replacement links were used for the enforcement retest.

test: GUEST opens both fixtures after policy activation
expected: BFL-005.docx is denied and BFL-021.docx opens
observed: Guest received 403 Forbidden on BFL-005.docx and opened BFL-021.docx in view-only mode on retest.
notes: Operator readback identifies the file and guest context. Reuse the same links for rollback. Correlate the DLP event under LOG-01.

test: CONTROL opens BFL-005.docx after policy activation
expected: Ordinary internal access still works
observed: CONTROL opened BFL-005.docx after policy activation.
notes: Operator confirmed access with the internal control account.

test: Correlate rule match with the guest test
expected: Observed signal identifies fixture and policy rule in the test window
observed: SharePoint DLPRuleMatch at 2026-11-19 14:20:50 UTC identifies BFL-005.docx and the enabled BFL Case SIT – Guest Restriction rule. Actions included SPAccessTimeControl.
notes: The event used an administrative identity. Guest denial verified separately in DLP-02.

test: Simulate with fresh unlabeled copies
expected: BFLAutoPilot BFL-007.docx matches and BFLAutoPilot BFL-025.docx does not
observed: The completed simulation showed one SharePoint candidate named BFLAutoPilot BFL-007.docx with BFL Finance Case v2.
notes: The control was absent from the Items to review list.

test: Test an unlabeled positive and neutral after policy enablement
expected: BFLAutoPilot BFL-001.docx receives BFL Finance Confidential and BFLAutoPilot BFL-027.docx remains unlabeled after evaluation
observed: SharePoint displayed BFL Finance Confidential on BFLAutoPilot BFL-001.docx and a blank Sensitivity value on BFLAutoPilot BFL-027.docx.
notes: Operator confirmed BFLAutoPilot BFL-001.docx in Labeled items for the pilot policy.

test: Apply and read back BFL Retain 30 Days v2
expected: Label state and retain-only settings recorded for RET-BFL-023.docx
observed: PowerShell confirmed 30 days from labeling with Keep. Policy lookup confirmed the pilot site after publication showed Enabled (Success). The SharePoint site label list omitted v2.
notes: Verify the applied label on RET-BFL-023.docx when SharePoint offers v2.

test: Delete RET-BFL-023.docx as an authorized pilot user
expected: File absent from the active library after user deletion
notes: Prerequisite checked. SharePoint deletion for labeled content is On. Run after RET-01 confirms the label on the test copy.

test: Verify copy in the Preservation Hold library
expected: Matching copy confirmed independently of the recycle bin

test: Disable scoped DLP and repeat enforcement guest checks
expected: Policy off. Both links from the enforcement test open after processing.
observed: BFL SharePoint External Access showed Off and Sync completed. The guest opened BFL-005.docx and BFL-021.docx in Viewing through the retained enforcement links.
notes: Recovery was captured for BFL-005.docx. The neutral file and policy sync were confirmed by operator readback.

test: Verify final policy and subscription state
expected: Pilot changes checked and remaining retention or labels recorded
observed: Guest links were removed. The auto-labeling pilot was Off. Four file labels remained in Finance-Test. The two final trial readbacks showed expiration.
notes: The raw billing readbacks omitted product headings. Retention verification is tracked in RET-01 through RET-03.
